thesis: A fictional organization should consolidate all VPN egress into a single hub without reducing availability.

nodes.text: Consolidation will simplify operations without reducing availability.
The new hub has truly independent upstream and recovery paths.
Modeled management savings; not independently confirmed.
The single hub may concentrate the failure domains currently separated.
nodes.rationale: Common egress and management dependencies could break multiple branches together; topology evidence is absent.

nodes.text: Add redundant Internet circuits in a later project.
nodes.rationale: Additional circuits might provide underlay diversity, pending a complete dependency audit.
